meta.name: activity-listing
meta.description: Enumerate all implementation activities from an experiment design

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从实验设计中列出所有实施活动
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将实验设计转化为具体的实施步骤
copy.tagline_en: List all implementation activities from an experiment design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn an experiment design into actionable steps

howto.what: 当用户提供实验设计文档时，Claude会调用子代理，从文档中提取并列出所有需要执行的活动及其描述。
howto.when: 当用户提供实验设计文档并要求列出实施活动时触发。

say.text: 帮我从这个实验设计文档里列出所有的实施活动。
say.note: Claude会提取文档中的活动列表。

say.text: 列出这个实验设计所需的所有步骤。
分析这个实验设计，告诉我需要做哪些活动。
say.note: Claude会调用子代理列举活动。

howto.what_en: When you provide an experiment design document, Claude will spawn a subagent to extract and list all implementation activities with descriptions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an experiment design document and ask to enumerate implementation activities.

say_en.text: List all implementation activities from this experiment design document.
say_en.note: Claude will extract the activity list.

say_en.text: What steps are needed to execute this experiment design?
say_en.note: Claude will output activities with descriptions.

say_en.text: Analyze this design and tell me what activities are required.
say_en.note: Claude will spawn a subagent to enumerate activities.
